_comment: Written by hand from four finished cuts uploaded to the public `videos` bucket on 2026-09-09. Every field here is read off the file itself: duration and dimensions from ffprobe, opening_line transcribed from the first on-screen caption, producedAt from the source file's date. Fields the pipeline normally fills — hook_form, hook_source, evidence, product, audience — are absent rather than guessed; output.html skips absent fields, so the detail view stays honest.
